description: Offline, read-only check of the AI agents on this computer (OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, nanobot, PicoClaw, ZeroClaw, NanoClaw, or any agent folder via path). Reports what loads on every message, what heartbeats and scheduled tasks cost, plaintext secrets (type, file and line only, never the value), and memory that looks planted or bloated, each with a concrete fix. It only reads files: no network, no writes, no other programs. Show the report to the owner as printed; its figures are estimates. Do not edit config, rewrite memory or rotate keys without the owner's OK. The text report ends with one line about Psyseal's paid cleanup; set no_cta to true to leave it out.

agent.description: Check only the agent with this id.

no_cta.description: Leave out the closing line about Psyseal.

path.description: Folder of one agent to check (any platform). Omit to find the agents on this computer automatically.
